_comment: Rates in USD. Update rates_verified whenever you check the pricing pages. report.py warns when this is more than 90 days old. Model keys must match the strings in config.yaml exactly -- price() raises on an unknown model rather than recording zero, so a drifted key fails at the first billed call.

anthropic._comment: Per million tokens. cache_write_tokens is the 5-minute write (1.25x base input); record_anthropic maps cache_creation_input_tokens onto it. The 1-hour write is 2x base and is not used.

gemini._comment: Per image, at the image_size set in config.yaml. Images are billed by output tokens, so the price moves with resolution: 3.1 Flash Image is 0.022 (0.5K) / 0.034 (1K) / 0.050 (2K) / 0.076 (4K). The figure below is 2K, matching gemini.image_size. Google's own footnote on that page quotes double these rates against a $60/1M token figure while the table states $30/1M -- the table is self-consistent and is what is used here. Check an invoice before trusting a total. Character reference images are billed as input at $0.25/1M and are not recorded at all; at four refs per call that is a small but real undercount.

elevenlabs._comment: Credits are the billing unit and every product draws on one pool, so record credits and let the ledger convert. Text to speech on eleven_multilingual_v2 bills 1 credit per character; turbo and flash bill half. Sound effects bill a flat ~200 credits per generation regardless of length. The rate below must agree with elevenlabs.usd_per_1k_credits in config.yaml, which drives the dry-run estimate -- these are two views of one number and both need changing if your plan changes.

free_tier._comment: Informational only. The ledger records gross cost. Free tier is applied in the report so you can see both.
